entries.note: Only explicit test-mode startup creates the stdin reader. Commands enqueue ordinary SDL key/mouse/text/focus events and expose read-only state/rendered snapshots. Pointer commands can set modifier state and wheel commands carry signed precise deltas plus inversion metadata to exercise production mouse reporting. It does not start a network listener or replace real file/session/game operations with fixtures. Tests clean their owned process; this remains separate from the agent desktop-action protocol.
